name: Build Rais APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      zip_name:
        description: 'ZIP filename to build; leave blank to choose the most recently updated ZIP'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
  push:
    paths:
      - '*.zip'
      - '.github/workflows/build-android-apk.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      HAS_RELEASE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' }}
      ANDROID_HOME: /usr/local/lib/android/sdk
      ANDROID_SDK_ROOT: /usr/local/lib/android/sdk

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      # Intentionally do NOT use android-actions/setup-android: its setup step
      # is the source of the obsolete "Failed to find package 'tools'" error.
      - name: Install Android SDK packages
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
          if [[ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]]; then
            SDKMANAGER="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools" -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit)"
          fi
          if [[ -z "$SDKMANAGER" || ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]]; then
            echo "Could not find sdkmanager in $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools"
            exit 1
          fi
          yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses >/dev/null || true
          "$SDKMANAGER" "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"

      - name: Install Gradle 8.7
        run: |
          wget -q https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.7-bin.zip -O "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-8.7/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Select project ZIP
        id: select_zip
        shell: bash
        env:
          REQUESTED_ZIP: ${{ inputs.zip_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ -n "${REQUESTED_ZIP//[[:space:]]/}" ]]; then
            ZIP_NAME="$REQUESTED_ZIP"
            [[ "$ZIP_NAME" != */* && "$ZIP_NAME" == *.zip ]] || { echo "Enter only a ZIP filename, e.g. Rais.zip"; exit 1; }
            [[ -f "$ZIP_NAME" ]] || { echo "ZIP not found: $ZIP_NAME"; find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.zip' -printf '%f\n'; exit 1; }
          else
            ZIP_NAME=""
            LATEST_TIME=0
            while IFS= read -r candidate; do
              [[ -n "$candidate" ]] || continue
              t="$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- "$candidate" || true)"
              [[ -n "$t" ]] || t=0
              if (( t > LATEST_TIME )); then LATEST_TIME="$t"; ZIP_NAME="$candidate"; fi
            done < <(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.zip' -printf '%f\n')
            [[ -n "$ZIP_NAME" ]] || { echo "No ZIP file found in repository root."; exit 1; }
          fi
          echo "Building ZIP: $ZIP_NAME"
          echo "zip_name=$ZIP_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Extract project
        env:
          ZIP_NAME: ${{ steps.select_zip.outputs.zip_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir extracted
          unzip -q "$ZIP_NAME" -d extracted
          mkdir -p rais-project
          if [[ -f extracted/settings.gradle || -f extracted/settings.gradle.kts ]]; then
            cp -a extracted/. rais-project/
          else
            SETTINGS="$(find extracted -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name settings.gradle -o -name settings.gradle.kts \) -print -quit)"
            [[ -n "$SETTINGS" ]] || { echo "ZIP does not contain a Gradle Android project."; exit 1; }
            PROJECT_DIR="$(dirname "$SETTINGS")"
            mkdir rais-project
            cp -a "$PROJECT_DIR"/. rais-project/
          fi
          test -f rais-project/app/build.gradle -o -f rais-project/app/build.gradle.kts

      - name: Configure persistent release signing
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY == 'true'
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rais-release.jks"
          echo "RAIS_KEYSTORE_FILE=$RUNNER_TEMP/rais-release.jks" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEY_ALIAS=$KEY_ALIAS" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEY_PASSWORD=$KEY_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build signed release APK
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY == 'true'
        working-directory: rais-project
        run: gradle assembleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Build debug APK for testing only
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY != 'true'
        working-directory: rais-project
        run: gradle assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Upload release APK
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Rais-release-apk
          path: rais-project/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload debug APK (testing only)
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY != 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Rais-debug-test-only
          path: rais-project/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
